annotations.title: I bond rate by issue date

description: For an I bond bought in a given month: its fixed rate, the composite rate it earns in the current (or given) 6-month period, the months its rate changes, whether it can be cashed and the penalty, and every rate period since issue. Computed from the TreasuryDirect rate chart effective November 1, 2026.

as_of_month.description: Month to evaluate, YYYY-MM. Default: the current month.

issue_month.description: Issue month of the bond as YYYY-MM, for example "2023-01". The issue date is the first of the month you bought it.

name: get_i_bond_rate_for_issue_date
title: Get I bond rate for an issue date
